title: The Festival of Colors in Greenleaf Village
description: In the lush, green countryside of Greenleaf Village, children and families come together to celebrate the annual spring festival with music, games, and dazzling lights.

scenes.description: Ravi, a cheerful 10-year-old boy with short black hair and a bright yellow kurta, runs through green fields at sunrise with a basket of marigold flowers, birds flying overhead
scenes.visual_prompt: A boy in a yellow kurta running through lush green fields at sunrise, holding a basket of marigold flowers, birds in the sky, storybook style
scenes.narration: The festival morning begins with Ravi gathering fresh marigold flowers as the sun paints the fields golden.
scenes.subtitle: Morning Glow

scenes.description: Ravi joins Anya, Kiran, and Meera in the village square, where villagers hang colorful flags and lanterns between wooden houses
scenes.visual_prompt: Four children helping villagers decorate a square with colorful flags and lanterns, surrounded by green hills, cartoon style
scenes.narration: In the square, Ravi meets his friends as they help hang lanterns and flags for the big celebration.
scenes.subtitle: Decorating the Village

scenes.description: A lively parade with drummers, dancers in colorful clothes, children carrying flower garlands, and oxen decorated with flower crowns marching through the green village lanes
scenes.visual_prompt: Parade with drummers, dancers, children carrying flowers, oxen with crowns, lush green village background
scenes.narration: The parade begins! Drums beat, dancers twirl, and flowers fill the air with their sweet scent.
scenes.subtitle: The Parade Begins

scenes.description: Children playing a sack race and throwing colored powders, laughing, while stalls offer sweets and sugarcane juice
scenes.visual_prompt: Kids in colorful clothes playing sack race, throwing colors, with sweet stalls in the background, bright festival atmosphere
scenes.narration: Games, colors, and treats make the festival sparkle with laughter and joy.
scenes.subtitle: Games and Colors

scenes.description: The sun setting behind the green hills as villagers dance in a circle around a bonfire, lanterns glowing in the trees
scenes.visual_prompt: Sunset over green hills, villagers dancing around bonfire, glowing lanterns hanging from trees
scenes.narration: As the day fades, music and dancing light up the village square.
scenes.subtitle: Evening Dance

scenes.description: Children releasing glowing paper lanterns into the night sky, reflections in the pond, fireflies glowing among the trees
scenes.visual_prompt: Children releasing glowing paper lanterns, starry night, reflections in pond, fireflies in trees
scenes.narration: Under the stars, they send lanterns into the sky, carrying their wishes for joy and togetherness.
scenes.subtitle: Wishes in the Sky
